lead: A number as text in the language of the app, as a `<data>` element with the exact value: a count, a percentage, an amount of money, a size. It follows the `locale` of ConfigProvider, so a page needs no `Math.round(x * 100)` and `%` of its own. `formatNumberText` gives the same text as a string (a CSV cell, a title). For dates use [Date Text](/date-text).

usage.title: Usage
usage.description: Digits are grouped the way the language does it.

percent.title: Percent
percent.description: `format="percent"` takes a fraction (0.97 is 97%); a number that is already a percentage (97) is `format="unit"` with `unit="percent"`. `precision` is how many digits follow the point, always that many.

money.title: Money
money.description: `format="currency"` with the `currency` code; the symbol and where it goes come from the language.

compact.title: Compact
compact.description: `notation="compact"` shortens a large number: "13K", "3.2M"; other languages shorten it their own way.

empty.title: No value
empty.description: A missing value, or one that is not a number, shows `fallback`, a dash by default.

styling.title: Styling Reference
styling.description: NumberText renders a plain `<data>` with no slot: style it with the text around it.
